messages:
Anika (AE): FYI Cypress AI kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need alignment on success criteria, security asks, and a quick pricing note. Who can join?

Tom (Solutions Eng): I can. I'll bring an eval plan and prompt set. Which dataset will they give us for the demo, S3 or CSV?

Jordan (Customer Eng): They'll provide S3 read-only access. Two flows: intent classification over tickets (latency-sensitive) and multi-turn assistant over internal docs (large context). We'll share a 20k-row doc index and convo transcripts.

Ravi (Sales Eng): Procurement asked for token cost estimate for a 2-week POC and a reserved-capacity uplift. Can we get a rough ballpark?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: hosted PAYG maybe $150-400 for two weeks depending on batching/cache; dedicated increases infra but helps latency. For classifier bursts ~20 qps avg seq 64. Recommend smoke test 1k requests seq_len=512 to get baseline.

Priya (Security): Customer wants vendor questionnaire completed before keys are issued. I uploaded their form: https://files.example.com/cypress-security-q3. Need answers on data retention, KMS, and egress. Also they require EU data residency.

Anika (AE): Proposed success criteria: 1) intent classifier >= 88% F1 on their eval set, 2) assistant median latency < 300ms single-turn, 3) no PII in a 50-sample audit. OK?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Agree. I'll own the eval harness and produce an eval rubric. For the PII audit I'll share a small scrub script and checklist.

Priya (Security): Please add the KMS integration doc link so I can complete the vendor form. Also confirm hosted EU-only capability; if not, we'll need Dedicated in EU or Private.

Tom (Solutions Eng): KMS doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/kms-integration. Scrub snippet I'll drop in the kickoff folder. Example: ```python
def scrub(text):
  return re.sub(r"\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b","[REDACTED]", text)
```

Ravi (Sales Eng): For the deck I'll include two cost options: hosted PAYG estimate and a short reserved quote for 10 days. Need token/sec numbers for their workload (Tom?).

Tom (Solutions Eng): For classifier pattern ~200 tokens/sec per vCPU baseline; give range in the deck and note variability by batching and cache hits.

Jordan (Customer Eng): Timeline: they want results in 10 business days. Proposed schedule: Day 0 ingest, Days 1-3 evals & prompt tuning, Days 4-7 stress/latency tuning, Days 8-10 final report + optional dedicated run. Tight but doable.

Anika (AE): Draft kickoff agenda (10am PT, 45m): 0-5m intros/goals; 5-15m customer use case (Jordan); 15-25m success criteria & eval plan (Tom); 25-35m security/data handling (Priya); 35-40m pricing & provisioning options (Ravi); 40-45m next steps/action owners.

Priya (Security): I'll draft vendor form answers and confirm data egress/regions. Need someone to point to the PII audit checklist.

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll upload eval harness, prompt templates (3), scrub script, and the 50-sample audit checklist to the kickoff folder by EOD.

Ravi (Sales Eng): I'll flag EU residency and legal contact in the pre-kickoff email and prepare pricing slides.

Anika (AE): Action items before kickoff: Tom uploads artifacts; Priya completes vendor form draft; Ravi readies pricing slide; Jordan confirms S3 path and legal POC. I'll send calendar invite with links. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Reminder: complete "Vendor Security Intake" doc. Link: https://vault.example.com/vendor-intake

Anika (AE): Thanks all  see you tomorrow.
